title: Adachi Rei Copper Golems
description: Replaces Copper Golems with Adachi Rei (and friends).  Requires the Entity Model Features mod or Optifine.
body:
# Adachi Rei Copper Golems
This Custom Entity Models resource pack changes the Copper Golem to look like the popular vocalsynth Adachi Rei and other related characters.  It requires the [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) mod or [Optifine](https://optifine.net).

Pictured from left to right:
- Unaffected Copper Golem: Adachi Rei (UTAU)
- Exposed Copper Golem: Adachi Rei (VOCALOID)
- Weathered Copper Golem: Tsukumo Shion
- Oxidized Copper Golem: Chahakobi Meguri

![Mechanical Girls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FcebP2nd/images/e3014363257b12b3c1a00e86fd328c067abe69b6.png)

![Mechanical Girl Statues](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FcebP2nd/images/d25fd39bec7373986c0ce9c2c39d0eec3dddb121.png)

The following languages have been updated to reflect these changes to the Copper Golem:
- English (US, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, New Zealand)
- ɥsᴉꞁᵷuƎ (uʍoᗡ ǝpᴉsd∩)
- 日本語 (日本)
- Pirate Speak (The Seven Seas)
- LOLCAT (Kingdom of Cats)
- Anglish (Oned Riches)
- Shakespearean English (Kingdom of England)

![Collage of supported languages](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FcebP2nd/images/15794ebaccfac230a4faae54181bb8d09113e638.png)

Thank you for downloading this resource pack.  I hope you enjoy it!

![Character Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FcebP2nd/images/6a99071778d6297857ec0fa9f429d5a28be41978.png)
